body:
> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **This issue was filed by an AI agent** (Claude, running in the [Pi](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono) coding agent) on behalf of @yoavweiss, migrating still-live issues out of [WICG/navigation-api](https://github.com/WICG/navigation-api) before that repository is archived. The migration scope was agreed with @noamr.
>
> This is a **migration of an existing discussion, not a new proposal**. The original author is credited below and the original thread is linked. Filed for triage — cc @noamr.

**Migrated from:** WICG/navigation-api#9 — filed by @domenic (2021-02). 23 comments, active to 2024-09. **This is the most-referenced open request in that repo**, so this issue is filed as an umbrella also covering WICG/navigation-api#226, #261 and #276, which are all facets of the same ask.

---

Because the navigation API is scoped to same-origin same-frame entries, manipulating that list is not a security problem: deleting the previous entry is broadly equivalent to `window.onload = () => history.back()` on a same-origin page. So we have far more freedom here than with `window.history`.

### Requested capabilities

- **Delete / invalidate entries** — e.g. after a resource is deleted, so back doesn't land on a 404.
- **Rearrange entries** — for stack-like navigation patterns.
- **Update URLs of non-current entries** — without triggering a navigation.

### Facets from the other migrated issues

**Stack/group-based patterns** (WICG/navigation-api#226, @k-egor-smirnov): apps with a tab UI want multiple independent history stacks. Traversing to a saved key fails once that branch is replaced, because forward-pruning discards it. The ask is effectively several parallel entry lists.

**Ephemeral entries** (WICG/navigation-api#261, @clshortfuse): the dialog case. Push an entry when a dialog opens, user presses back, dialog closes — but a stale forward entry remains until something else overwrites it. There's no way to mark an entry as "don't come back to this; skip it".

**Undo/redo** (WICG/navigation-api#276, @KevinDoughty): document-based apps want to drive undo/redo from navigation. Explicitly depends on this feature, and needs URLs of multiple entries changed simultaneously without navigating. Filed acknowledging it's contentious.

### Related

WICG/navigation-api#205 proposed a general `entrieschange` event, which would likely be needed alongside any of this so apps can observe the resulting mutations. WICG/navigation-api#41 (recovering data from replaced entries) is the read-side counterpart.

cc @domenic @k-egor-smirnov @clshortfuse @KevinDoughty
